summary: A command-line to-do app that stores tasks in a local JSON file. Hand-written sample brief for milestone 1.

files.README.md:
# tasklite

A tiny to-do list for your terminal.

## Install

pip install tasklite

## Usage

tasklite add "buy milk"
tasklite list
tasklite done 1

Tasks are saved to ~/.tasklite.json.

demo.text: I run tasklite add "buy milk" and nothing is printed.
I run tasklite list and see: 1 [ ] buy milk
I run tasklite done 5 with only one task and the app crashes with IndexError.
